item.title: ROB HALFORD on JUDAS PRIEST’s Turbo Backlash: 'Everybody Wanted To Throw It In The Bin'
item.description: In a new interview with U.K.’s Planet Rock, Rob Halford spoke about JUDAS PRIEST’s upcoming headlining appearance at the 2026 edition of the Bloodstock Open Air festival.

item.title: MAX CAVALERA Explains Why a Second NAILBOMB Album Will Never Happen
item.description: Max Cavalera has once again shot down the possibility of a second NAILBOMB studio album, maintaining that the project’s legacy is best preserved as a “cult” one-off.

item.title: Marilyn Manson Draws 205,000 Fans to Controversial Free Concert in Mexico
item.description: On August 10, Marilyn Manson drew an estimated 205,000 people to the Teatro del Pueblo at the National Fair of San Luis Potosí (FENAPO) in central Mexico. The free concert, organized by the state government, sparked protests from religious and conservative groups who said the artist was “inappropriate” for what they considered a family-oriented event.

item.title: DIMMU BORGIR Announces New Guitarist Kjell Åge “Damage” Karlsen Ahead of Tons of Rock Festival
item.description: Norwegian metal band Dimmu Borgir has a new guitarist. The group announced that Kjell Åge “Damage” Karlsen has joined their lineup. He played his first show with the band on June 27 at the Tons of Rock festival in Oslo, Norway (watch it below).

item.title: Steel Panther Expands 2025 "Feel The Steel" Tour With New U.S. And Europe Dates
item.description: Fifteen years after dropping their debut Feel The Steel, Steel Panther is still out there doing what they do best: mocking, exaggerating, and somehow keeping hair metal alive with a straight face and a wink.

item.title: Festival Canceled: Sick New World 2025 Won’t Happen
item.description: Looks like Sick New World 2025 is joining the growing list of festivals that never make it past the announcement phase. Scheduled for April 12, 2025, in Las Vegas, this highly-hyped event has been officially scrapped.

item.title: Sick New World 2025 Lineup Announced: Metallica, Linkin Park & More
item.description: Sick New World 2025 is coming in hard, and this lineup is anything but subtle. Let’s cut to the chase—Metallica and Linkin Park are headlining. What? Metallica showing up at a festival that usually leans nü-metal?

item.title: Slipknot Reveals Knotfest Argentina and Chile Lineups; See Details
item.description: Slipknot is packing its bags—and masks—for another jaunt through South America, this time with Brazilian powerhouse drummer Eloy Casagrande on the roster. The Knotfest machine is revving up for Argentina and Chile, hot on the heels of announcing Knotfest Brazil.

item.title: Slipknot Celebrates 25 Years at Knotfest Brazil; See Details
item.description: Back in 1999, we were all panicking about Y2K taking down the world’s tech, arguing over a president’s private escapades instead of governmental coups, and gleefully downloading Metallica tracks despite their infamous Napster tantrum.
